title: Twitter Cyclone 3rd ET USA product page and geometry recheck
notes: Current USA regional product page specifies a threaded T47×24 mm bottom bracket and RS folding reflective-edge 700×28C fitted tires. Its six-size geometry chart publishes coordinates including stack, reach, chainstay and wheelbase, while multiple columns are blank and an entry labeled BB Drop is displayed as -68.37 with an unclear basis; only legible existing coordinates are retained. The same exact page first lists a 420×90 mm high-modulus carbon integrated cockpit, then later says every build has an alloy integrated bar/stem at 400×90 mm. Do not select either cockpit claim without an exact build mapping. The regional listing does not establish mainland-trim equivalence or maximum tire clearance.

classification_history.reason: Operator identifies itself as a regional U.S. distributor; authorization is self-described, not independently verified.

authority_note: Regional US distributor source. Its statement of authorization is self-described; this source is not the manufacturer or evidence of mainland-China price or warranty.
